title: Second-order fields for stochastic partial differential equations
summary: In this article, we study the second-order fluctuation of the solutions of one-dimensional polynomial stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) of the form \begin{equation*} (\partial_t - Δ) Φ_{\varepsilon} = -P(Φ_{\varepsilon}) + ξ_{\varepsilon}, \end{equation*} where $P$ is a polynomial of degree greater than or equal to $2$, $ξ_\varepsilon$ is the white-noise after being convoluted (in space) by the heat kernel $K_\varepsilon = e^{\varepsilon Δ}$.
